html.body: Date: 2025-04-18 REMARKSUpon entry of this amendment, claims 1-10 are pending. Claims 1 and 8 have been amended. While Applicant disagrees with the current rejections, Applicant has amended the claims to expedite prosecution. As for the drawings, Fig. 2 is amended. Furthermore, the specification is amended to correct the numerals, including 232, 231, 252 and 251. No new matter is added.Drawings (1) Fig.2 is objected, because item 231, which refers to a central through -hole, and item 232, which refers to steel wire through-holes, point to the wrong holes in Fig. 2.Regarding this matter, Fig. 2 has been amended such that the position for callout 231 and callout 232 are adjusted so that they point to the correct holes, with 231 pointing to the central through hole and 232 pointing to the steel wire through-hole.(2) The drawings are further objected to under 37 CFR 1.83(a) because they fail to show the steel wire rope through-hole 252 as described in the specification.Regarding this matter, "the steel wire rope through-hole 252" has been amended to "the steel wire rope through-hole 232", and "central through-hole 251" has been amended to "central through-hole 231".Each platform has a "central through-hole 231" and "the steel wire rope through-hole 232", the reference callout for central through-holes should be "231" and the reference callout for steel wire rope through-holes should be "232" for each platform. Reference callouts 252 and 251 were used by mistake.The amended Fig. 2 is in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d), accordingly. Reconsideration and withdrawal of the objections of drawings are respectfully requested.Specification Regarding the matter "reference characters 232 and 252 have been used to designate steel wire rope through-holes, see page 11, lines 20-24 and page 12, lines 5-10".The specification has been amended to clarify that reference character 232 is used to designate a designate steel wire rope through-hole, and the reference character 231 is used to designate a central through-hole.The amended reference characters should be clear, and thus, reconsideration and withdrawal of the objection of specification is respectfully requested.Claim objections (1) Applicant, at claim 1, line 10, may wish to replace "two ends" with "each end" and "when" With "where" or "wherein"' Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by replacing "two ends" with "each end" and "when" with "where", at claim 1, line 10.(2) Applicant, at claim 1, line 11, may wish to replace "the two ends" with "one end".Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by replacing "the two ends" with "one end" , at claim 1, line 11.(3) Applicant, at claim 1, line 11, may wish to add "relative to an other platform" after "fixed";Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by adding "relative to another platform" after "fixed", at claim 1, line 11.(4) Applicant, at claim 1, line 13, may wish to delete "always";Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by deleting "always" at claim 1, line 13; and deleting the phrase "the movable linkage comprises at least a link" at lines 7-8.(5) Applicant, at claim 1, line 15, may wish to replace "each link" with "a respective link";Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by replacing "each link" with "a respective link", at claim 1, line 15.(6) Applicant, at claim 1, line 16, may wish to replace "one link" with "'a respective link".Regarding this matter, claim 1 is amended by replacing "one link" with "a respective link".Amended as above, objections of the claims should be overcome, accordingly, reconsideration and withdrawal of the objections are respectfully requested.Claims Rejections-35U.S.C.112 (1) Claim 8 describes a middle section of the sleeve steel wire rope passing through each platform.As each sleeve steel wire rope is connected to the base of the driving body, does each sleeve steel wire rope pass through each platform?Regarding this matter, the applicant clarifies that each sleeve steel wire rope passes through each platform. That is, each platform has its steel wire rope through-hole (232), the sleeve steel wire rope passes through the steel wire rope through-hole (232) of each platform.(2) Claim 1 recites the limitation "the two adjacent platforms" in line 12.Regarding this matter, the applicant has amended "the two adjacent platforms" in line 12 as "two adjacent platforms".(3) Claim 8 recites the limitation "the sleeve" in line 4.Regarding this matter, the applicant has amended "the sleeve" in line 4 as "a sleeve".(4) Claim 8 recites the limitation "the sleeves of m steel wire ropes" in line 8.Regarding this matter, the applicant has amended "the sleeves of m steel wire ropes" in line 8 as "sleeves of m steel wire ropes".(5) Claim 8 recites the limitation "the other joints" in line 11.Regarding this matter, the applicant has amended "the other joints" in line 11 as "other joints".Amended as above, rejections of the claims should be overcome, accordingly, reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections are respectfully requested.In view of the above, the undersigned representative respectfully submits that the foregoing Response places this application in condition for allowance and a Notice to that effect is earnestly solicited. If the Examiner believes that there are any issues that can be resolved by a telephone conference, or that there are any informalities that can be corrected by an Examiner's amendment, please call the undersigned representative at the number given below.The undersigned representative requests any extension of time that may be deemed necessary to further the prosecution of this application.Respectfully submitted By /Clifford O. Chi/ Clifford O. Chi Reg. No. 62,409 310-497-0181
